D: A dad who missed too much of his son's life comes back as a snowman for one last Christmas.
P: Serve the snacks when the snowman comes to life.
S: Snow day toastie fingers with tomato soup
Crisp cheese toasties cut in fingers, with homemade tomato soup

Golden ham, cheddar and mustard toasties cut into fingers for dunking into little cups of creamy tomato soup. Fry 1 diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add 2 x 400g tins crushed tomatoes, 300ml chicken stock and 1 tsp sugar and simmer 15 minutes. Blitz smooth and stir in 50ml cream. Spread 8 slices bread with mustard and make 4 sandwiches with 150g ham and 150g grated cheddar. Butter the outsides and fry 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into fingers and serve with cups of soup.
Grilled franks in pretzel buns with slow-fried onions and mustard

Smoky frankfurts in soft pretzel buns with sweet fried onions, mild mustard, crunchy pickles and a little shredded cheddar. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in 20g butter for 15 minutes until golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts in water for 5 minutes, then grill 2 minutes for colour. Warm 8 pretzel buns or soft rolls in the oven for 4 minutes. Split, add a frankfurt to each, then top with the onions, a squeeze of American mustard, sliced pickles and 80g grated cheddar.
M: Frost family roast beef and Yorkshires
Mustard rosemary roast beef, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy

Herb-crusted roast beef with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes, honey carrots and a jug of rich gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with mustard, rosemary and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour for medium rare, with 1.2kg parboiled potatoes in oil on another tray. Rest 15 minutes. Turn the oven to 220C. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g plain flour and 150ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each of 8 muffin holes for 5 minutes, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with buttercream rolled in coconut, snowman faces

Light vanilla cupcakes with fluffy white buttercream rolled in coconut, with chocolate chip eyes and a little orange lolly nose. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Divide between 12 cases and bake at 180C for 18 minutes. Cool. Beat 150g butter with 300g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla until fluffy and white. Dome onto each cupcake and roll in 80g desiccated coconut. Press in 2 chocolate chips for eyes and a small orange lolly for a nose.
K: Hot white chocolate with cinnamon, whipped cream and coconut

Creamy white hot chocolate with vanilla and a hint of cinnamon, topped with whipped cream and a snowfall of desiccated coconut. Heat 1L full cream milk with 1 cinnamon stick until steaming. Remove the cinnamon and whisk in 150g chopped white chocolate and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth and frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, top with whipped cream from 150ml thickened cream and sprinkle with 2 tbsp desiccated coconut so it looks like fresh snow.

dishes.n: Snow day toastie fingers with tomato soup

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer, then blitz smooth and stir in the cream.
Spread the bread with mustard and make sandwiches with ham and cheddar. Butter the outsides.
Fry until golden on both sides.
Cut into fingers and serve with cups of soup.

dishes.n: Frost family roast beef and Yorkshires

steps.text: Rub the beef with the mustard, rosemary and salt. Parboil the potatoes and toss in oil.
Roast the beef at 200C for medium rare, with the potatoes and honey-tossed carrots on another tray.
Rest the beef and turn the oven to 220C. Whisk the eggs, flour and milk into a batter.
Heat a little oil in each hole of a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake without opening the oven.
Make gravy from the juices with a spoon of the flour and the stock.

veg.n: Frost family nut roast and Yorkshires
veg.make_ahead: Nut roast mix up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus 1 tbsp for the gravy

steps.text: Fry the onion and mushrooms in the olive oil until dry. Mix with the nuts, breadcrumbs, cheddar, 2 of the eggs, the mustard, rosemary and salt and press into a lined loaf tin.
Toss the potatoes in 2 tbsp of the vegetable oil. Roast the nut roast at 200C with the potatoes and the honey-tossed carrots on another tray.
Rest the nut roast in its tin and turn the oven to 220C. Whisk the other 2 eggs, the flour and milk into a batter.
Heat the remaining vegetable oil in the holes of a muffin tin, pour in the batter and bake without opening the oven.
Cook the spoon of flour in a little fat from the potato tray, then whisk in the stock and soy and simmer into gravy.
Beat some of the butter with the sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Divide into cupcake cases and bake at 180C.
Cool completely.
Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and vanilla until fluffy and white.
Dome onto each cupcake and roll in coconut. Press in chocolate chips for eyes and a lolly for a nose.
Heat the milk with the cinnamon until steaming.
Remove the cinnamon and whisk in the white chocolate and vanilla until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs, top with whipped cream and sprinkle with coconut like fresh snow.
